discription: A pulse wave synth with an ADSR amplitude envelope and an envelope-controlled resonant low-pass filter. The filter's cutoff frequency sweeps with its own ADSR envelope, adding dynamic character.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, width=0.5, rq=0.5, cutoffBase=1000, cutoffDepth=4000, atk=0.01, dec=0.1, sus=0.8, rel=1.0, curve=-4; var sig; var ampEnv = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(atk, dec, sus, rel, curve: curve), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var filterEnv = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate); var filterFreq = cutoffBase + (filterEnv * cutoffDepth); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, width); sig = LPF.ar(sig, filterFreq.clip(40, 20000), rq); sig = sig * amp * ampEnv; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
